main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Free Yourself from the Illusion of the Demiurge
header_desc: By intertwining first-century spirituality with twenty-first-century physics, this work addresses the primordial question about our place in the cosmos. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in two-thousand-year-old texts: the Gnostic gospels. The ego has mass and creates the material prison by curving your space-time.
left_title: The Christian Cross as a Key to Awakening from the Illusion of Time
left_body: Matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. If the ego curves space-time, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche 🧠, while the timeless belongs to the pneuma ❤️. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one invites us to shed the false self to return to the flat light of the Invisible Father. Thus, the Pleroma is revealed as a flat space-time against the material prison of curved space-time, showing that the Christian cross is the key to awakening from the illusion of time.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3): the divine wisdom of Sophia in the right hemisphere versus the material ignorance of Yaldabaoth in the left hemisphere reveals the duality of human consciousness, granting us a free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE❤️ | EGO 🧠 ⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws don't distinguish between past and future, Einstein's breaking of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and the Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening foretold by the Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as a cognitive prison of the ego, versus the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The capital affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation with the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of over two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white male, larger than usual, with a flowing beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the sum total of the physical laws that govern the universe, then there clearly is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there's not much point in praying to the law of gravity.
